name: Midnight Moon
source:
Welcome to Miyahara Town.
You wake up suddenly in the middle of the night. Unable to fall back asleep, you venture outside to a forest, and meet four girls, whichever one you choose to romance will forever change your love life for the better.

Akarui, a puzzle-solving, clumsy girl with a childlike personality and a heart of gold.

Miyu, an amateur programmer and geek with a soft spot for video games and computers. 

Sora, the de facto leader of the four girls with a burning intent to one day reach the stars. 

Yami, an enigmatic, gothic maiden who dares to reckon with supernatural forces.

Which one will you choose?

[From [url=https://springingtraps.itch.io/midnight-moon] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到宫原町。
你在半夜突然醒来。由于无法入睡，你冒险前往森林，遇到了四个女孩，无论你选择与哪一个建立浪漫关系，都将永远让你的爱情生活变得更好。

阿卡瑞，一个解谜、笨拙的女孩，有着孩子气的个性和一颗金子般的心。

Miyu，一名业余程序员和极客，对电子游戏和计算机情有独钟。

索拉是四个女孩事实上的领导者，她热衷于有一天到达星星。

雅米，一位敢于对抗超自然力量的神秘哥特式少女。

你会选择哪一个？
